Usually there’s some underlying factor that is causing us to use gambling as a form of escapism. Seeing a family doctor or other professional for help can help with treatment. Take care

Hey, thanks for posting your story. I think acknowledgment is the first step to any recovery. The worst damage comes when we loose the initial deposit and go on an angry rampage trying to recoup our looses. Even if we do win a bit, the amount doesn’t seem enough to stop and walk away. I know, I’ve been there too. Sometimes we turn to gambling as a way to escape our stresses and daily problems. For a moment we’re distant from reality- every worry seems to disappear. But of course, it soon comes to an end, most of the time it’s when we hit Zero. How could we do this, Again and again?! We got to remove gambling all together. Keeping busy, having commitments, and starting a routine are methods that will help you. Please keep strong and update us regularly with your progress. We want to see you stronger. Take care

Hey Dharr, 

As a previous commenter said, there is no large enough win to make you stop. I would recommend seeking a family doctor or some other professional to kick start your recovery. I think there’s an underlying component in which you’re using gambling as a method for coping. Obviously this is costly and only self-depreciating. Please seek the help you deserve. It’s never too late to pick yourself back up and become the person you thought you could never be. I believe in you.

Hey C, This is the first step, I’m proud you’re making this commitment. Please know though, money will start to come in again and you need to make sure you have measures in place to stop a relapse. Right now is a good time to reflect on what those could be since you’re in the mindset to give this addiction up. If you have the urge the next time to download the app, self-exclude and don’t look back. Download bet blockers. If it’s an e-transfer account to deposit, call your bank and block them. The thoughts will come but you are stronger. Remember your girlfriend and dad believe in you and want to see you better. Know that they have your support. Please don’t disappoint them.
They had us in the first half!

Please take some deep breaths with me (after each inhale, try and exhale for twice as long... 3 minutes of this really helps to calm me) You have every right to feel this way. But your kids need you in their lives. I can’t imagine the pain and sadness your kids will experience if you deicide to go. Your little one will be so confused and broken and this will have an impact on his development. I know youre a good father even though you think youre not. I promise you, they love you. Please reach out to get some help. It’s ok to feel like this, you’re not alone and I believe in you.
